scope: Two separate temporary normal Chromium processes on one Windows host; synthetic source slices and OPFS destination. Direct harness SDP exchange, not application pairing, human authorization, physical LAN, source disk or native destination validation.
rawBaseline: Same ordered channel, 60 KiB payload plus 44 bytes, 96-block window, 8/2 MiB buffering thresholds and production 64-block/75 ms receive queue; pattern check and batched ACKs, no hashing/source reads/OPFS durability.
fixtureGeneration: 256-byte periodic pattern expanded with bounded typed-array copies; same bytes as the original file-index/offset formula. Destination audit uses the independent per-byte formula.

cpu.note: CPU sums observed browser processes across their threads; CPU from processes that exited between snapshots is unavailable. Timing excludes launch/module import and includes preparation, transfer and verification.

postRunHeap.note: Forced collection is diagnostic, outside the timed run. Does not include all browser/native memory.

postRunProcessMemory.note: Diagnostic snapshots after timed work. Main-page collection does not force collection in every worker or release every native allocation.

processMemory.note: Opt-in observer overhead affects timings. Windows private bytes and working sets are summed only for IDs reported by each isolated browser. Working-set sums can double-count shared pages. Phase transitions are labeled separately; periodic sampling can miss peaks and newly created processes.
